Dawn and Piplup are getting serious about their training—maybe too serious. Meanwhile, the Team Rocket trio are trying to get back in shape after their cushy Summer Academy job…

As Team Galactic continues its evil quest to steal the Lustrous Orb, Champion Cynthia and our heroes discover they must battle both Team Galactic and Team Rocket to protect it!
Taking some time off to visit their friend Angie on their way to Hearthome City, our heroes investigate the mystery of the Scarf Monster!

After an explosion separates Trainers and Pokémon, Meowth entertains the idea of quitting Team Rocket and joining up with our heroes!

The day of Ash’s battle with Byron at the Canalave Gym has arrived, and battling with this Gym Leader is something Ash will never forget!
When our heroes find a group of Wailord blocking the boat that was to take them to Chocovine Town, Ash discovers an ailing Wailmer with a big problem!
After rushing to Iron Island to help out their friend Barry and his struggling Empoleon, our heroes discover that all the island’s Steel-type Pokémon are in the same state!
Our heroes have joined forces with Riley and his Lucario to battle Team Galactic for the fate of Iron Island!
After being kidnapped by Team Rocket, Pikachu and Piplup are stranded on a deserted island, where they meet a lot of friendly Pokémon—and one that's friendly and mysterious!
Our heroes discover that Chocovine Town is one of the few places where the rare Pokémon Phione can be seen!
The day of the Chocovine Contest has finally arrived, and Dawn is faced with an opponent angrily determined to settle an old score!
On their way to Snowpoint City and Ash’s next Gym battle, our heroes come across a most unusual Officer Jenny and her buddy Chatot!
After getting lost in a blinding snowstorm on their way to Snowpoint City, our heroes come across a Froslass desperate to find its lost pal Snorunt.
When our heroes and Team Rocket find themselves in a gourmet noodle shop, a chain of circumstances leads to a Team Rocket breakup!
On their way to Snowpoint City and Ash’s next Gym battle, our heroes make a stop in Squallville for a Pokéringer competition, a special event for flying Pokémon!
Continuing toward Snowpoint City, our heroes come across a fierce Aggron who provides Dawn and Mamoswine with a chance to learn and grow together.
On their way to Snowpoint City and Ash’s next Gym battle, our heroes discover a lonely Snover who offers Grotle an unexpected gift!

It’s the day of the Sandalstraw Pokémon Contest. Dawn and her old friend, also rival, Kenny are going head to head!
When our heroes decide to participate in the Pokémon Ping Pong competition, Ambipom’s exceptional talent presents Dawn with an exceptional dilemma!
Stopping at Shelter Town on their way to Snowpoint City, our heroes meet a young girl who judges all Pokémon by their cuteness!
After arriving in Snowpoint City and meeting up with Dawn’s rival Zoey, our heroes discover that Snowpoint Gym Leader Candice also teaches at the Pokémon Training School!
The moment of Ash’s Snowpoint City Gym battle is finally here and he now must face Candice and her formidable Pokémon!
Our heroes run into their old friend Brandon from the Battle Pyramid, as well as Ash’s rival, Paul, who challenges Brandon to a battle on the spot!
The evil Pokémon hunter, J, and her henchmen are on the loose again and this time they’re planning to capture the Legendary Pokémon Regigigas!

Quando o desejo de Katara de dominar a Água supera os limites, os garotos acabam fugindo de piratas.

As habilidades de Aang para fazer a paz são colocadas em teste quando as crianças encontram duas tribos rivais de refugiados que devem cruzar um cânion enorme em seu caminho para a capital do Reino da Terra, Ba Sing Se.
Uma incrível tempestade traz memórias dolorosas do passado e deixa todos em perigo no presente.

O grupo descobre uma aldeia onde as pessoas dependem das previsões de uma vidente para tudo. No entanto, ao descobrir que ela errou, os amigos terão que convencer as pessoas de que estão em perigo.
